sandbachFocus: Sandbach United were not in league action this weekend, instead competing in the FA Vase preliminary round against Ashby Ivanhoe. They suffered a narrow defeat in what they described as a disappointing performance, losing to higher-level opposition. The result came after Sandbach had picked up a midweek league win over New Mills (3-1) on Tuesday, suggesting inconsistent form heading into the weekend cup tie.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth maintained their excellent start with a 4-1 home victory over Crewe, with Zazi scoring twice to keep them unbeaten. Wolverhampton Casuals, despite their early-season dominance, saw their unbeaten run end with a 2-1 defeat to Eccleshall on Tuesday, then bounced back with a 1-0 away win at Dawley Town on Saturday, courtesy of Liam Kirton's 66th-minute goal. Shawbury United edged past Widnes Town 3-2 in an entertaining encounter, with Ethan Pickford among the scorers. Bilston Town impressed with a dominant 3-0 away victory at Brereton Social. The cup competitions dominated the weekend agenda across the division, with most clubs engaged in FA Vase action rather than league fixtures. Eccleshall produced a particularly impressive display, demolishing Allscott Heath 4-0 in the Vase, while Telford Town progressed via penalties against Darlaston Town. Market Drayton Town, Stafford Town, and New Mills all exited the Vase, with several fixtures contested between league clubs and higher-level opposition.
